number: 第二百四十八条の四の二十二
heading_en: Sensitivities, etc. of Delta Risk Factors for Credit Spreads of Counterparties
summary_ja: 取引相手方のクレジット・スプレッドのデルタ・リスク・ファクターは、各テナーの個社及び適格インデックスのスプレッドの絶対変化とし、リスク・ウェイトを表で定め、ρ_{kl}はテナー・銘柄・信用力の相関の積とする。
summary_en: The counterparty credit spread delta risk factors are absolute changes in individual-entity and eligible-index spreads at each tenor, with risk weights from a table and ρ_{kl} the product of tenor, name and quality correlations.
paragraphs: The delta risk factors relating to credit spreads for counterparties shall be the absolute change in the credit spread of each individual entity (meaning the counterparty and the reference names relating to hedging instruments for the credit spread of the counterparty) and of each eligible index, for each of the following types of tenor. (i) Six months. (ii) One year. (iii) Three years. (iv) Five years. (v) Ten years.

The "absolute change in the credit spread" in the preceding paragraph means the value obtained by dividing the change in the value of CVA or of a CVA hedging instrument when the credit spread is changed by one basis point by 0.0001.

The risk weight RW_{k} of the risk factors provided in paragraph (1) shall be as set out in the following table, for all types of tenor, according to the bucket number and the category of creditworthiness. {{T:p290t1}}

The correlation coefficient ρ_{kl} between the weighted sensitivities WS_{k} and WS_{l} for bucket numbers 1 through 7 in the table in the preceding paragraph shall be the value obtained by the following formula. ρ_{kl} = ρ_{tenor}·ρ_{name}·ρ_{quality}

In the case of the preceding paragraph, the values of the correlation coefficients listed in the following items shall be as provided in those items. (i) The correlation coefficient ρ_{tenor}: the value specified in (a) or (b) below according to the category of case listed there. (a) Where both tenors are the same: 100%. (b) Cases other than that listed in (a): 90%. (ii) The correlation coefficient ρ_{name}: the value specified in (a) through (c) below according to the category of case listed there. (a) Where both names are the same: 100%. (b) Where both names are not the same and are legally related: 90%. (c) Cases other than those listed in (a) and (b): 50%. (iii) The correlation coefficient ρ_{quality}: the value specified in (a) or (b) below according to the category of case listed there. (a) Where the creditworthiness of both names is the same (meaning where both names are investment grade, where both names are speculative grade, where both names are unrated, or where one name is speculative grade and the other is unrated): 100%. (b) Cases other than that listed in (a): 80%.

The correlation coefficient ρ_{kl} between the net weighted sensitivities WS_{k} and WS_{l} for bucket number 8 in the table in paragraph (3) shall be the value obtained by the following formula. ρ_{kl} = ρ_{tenor}·ρ_{name}·ρ_{quality}

In the case of the preceding paragraph, the values of the correlation coefficients listed in the following items shall be as provided in those items. (i) The correlation coefficient ρ_{tenor}: the value specified in (a) or (b) below according to the category of case listed there. (a) Where both tenors are the same: 100%. (b) Cases other than that listed in (a): 90%. (ii) The correlation coefficient ρ_{name}: the value specified in (a) through (c) below according to the category of case listed there. (a) Where the names of both indices are the same and the series of both indices are the same: 100%. (b) Where the names of both indices are the same and the series of both indices are not the same: 90%. (c) Cases other than those listed in (a) and (b): 80%. (iii) The correlation coefficient ρ_{quality}: the value specified in (a) or (b) below according to the category of case listed there. (a) Where the creditworthiness of both indices is the same (meaning where both indices are investment grade or where both indices are speculative grade): 100%. (b) Cases other than that listed in (a): 80%.
